pages.text: Weapons, staves and wands can roll $(item)sockets$(). Put a gem in at a smithing table; a Sigil of Socketing adds a socket. Armor has no sockets: for defensive gems, wear Jewelry rings and necklaces.
The $(item)Arcanist's Prism$() is a gem for staves and wands only: it adds spell power. Look for it in boss and dungeon loot.
